label: Body adiposity (belly-centred)

range.endpoint_anchor: belly core unchanged from v1/v3: max forward displacement at navel 0.1197 m on hm08 (Fat Males anchor scaled by torso-length ratio 0.8325); distribution layer calibrated separately (flank match, alpha capped 2.0) -- see distribution

region.mask_rule: belly core: v1 geodesic mask (r = 0.35 x torso_len) crossfaded against the whole-torso distribution field across the mask ring; distribution weight covers h in [-0.08, 1.03] of the torso parameter, graph-smoothed

semantics: Whole-torso adiposity SYSTEM (FAT_REFERENCE.md): the v3 pendant belly (drain/descent/drape, gamma=2) embedded in a learned fat-distribution field -- chest, flanks/love-handles, back, hips/glutes, shoulder roots -- with a posture shear (anterior pelvic tilt lobe + compensating chest lobe, kept after passing its effect gate). At +1 the silhouette is one heavy torso: waist girth +20 cm at the narrowest point, hips +11 cm, chest width +4.8 cm, back band +5.6 cm mean radial; no silhouette step at the old belly-mask boundary (ring gradient ratio 1.28 vs base). Limbs are NOT covered (v5 scope).

system.model: D4 = LIN + SAG; LIN = B*D_protrusion + (1-B)*D_distribution + D_crease(0: learned fields already carry the flank crease) + D_posture; SAG = B * D_sag3 (v3, gamma = 2.0)

distribution.blend: 0.5 * Fat Males full-torso field + 0.5 * alpha * HIMBO Chonky field (each scaled by its torso-length ratio)
distribution.calibration: flank-band match (mean |radial| over |theta| 1.1-1.9, h 0.3-0.6): the sources DISAGREE on the belly front (Fat Males peak 15.4 cm vs Chonky 3.3 cm -- pot-belly vs broad-mass bodies), so they are matched where the distribution's job lives and the belly core stays D_protrusion/D_sag3's job. Alpha hit its 2.0 cap: even doubled, Chonky's flanks are the lighter of the two; the blend leans Fat Males there.

system.whole_torso_gate: fold repair and the 0-flip gate run over ALL 12,298 torso faces (both bases), not just the belly patch

coupling.formula: shape(w) = base + w * LIN + f(w) * SAG

gravity.fold_repair: attenuation repair over the whole torso: 4 rounds, min attenuation 0.53, 67 verts touched (the distribution fields are intrinsically smooth; contrast v3's 40 rounds / 509 verts)

metrics_corrected.note: supersede the same-named first-pass metrics in qa.metrics where definitions overlap; see GRAVITY_V4.md

makehuman_hm08.base: hm08 (MPFB2 base.obj vertex order, 19158 verts; pure delta vs the macro-neutral base)

components.combined_at_+1: body.belly.protrusion_v4.target (= LIN_v4 + SAG_v3, for hosts without coupling support)
components.distribution_component: body.belly.protrusion_distribution_v4.target (= D4 - D3: everything v4 adds over v3 -- the distribution, posture and crossfade; stack it on v3 to reproduce v4, or use it standalone as a torso-mass layer under a different belly)

provenance.source: belly core: Fat Males morph (Skyrim) transferred v1. Distribution: 50/50 blend of (a) the Fat Males full-torso morph and (b) the HIMBO 'Chonky' preset recipe (17 Vanilla OSD blocks at the preset's big values; SamuelLike/FemmeB/FemmeBooba excluded -- other sets, one a body-swap; BellySmooth absent from the Vanilla OSD; TorsoWaistSize excluded -- direction ambiguous, its display name decodes to 'Shrink Waist'), each transferred by the v1 (h, theta) kernel machinery and flank-calibrated (alpha = 2.00, capped). Rules: FAT_REFERENCE.md.
